technical.summary: EOG displays strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 84, Stoch 96.5) combined with weak ADX trend strength and no active crossover signals suggest elevated pullback risk—suitable for continuation trades only with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: EOG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 44 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; Fear index (43) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (285.12) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 44 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major MAs with supertrend bullish, new 20-day highs, and RSI extreme overbought (83-84) suggests strong momentum continuation if breakout holds above 81.43 resistance.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (285.12), imminent CPI event (1 day), RSI/Stoch overbought with no crossover triggers, weak ADX (22.91), zero fundamental conviction, and no smart money alignment create unacceptable macro risk for swing entry.
